json_output.notes: Already has correlation support via JsonResponse structure

parser.notes: Uses result.try with dynamic.field() for parsing

main_cli.notes: Uses glint.CommandInput with input.args and input.flags

ffi.provides: UUID generation, timestamps, halt, env vars
ffi.notes: Can extend for stdin reading if needed

architecture.input_flow: stdin JSONL → parse line → extract command → validate → route → execute → JSONL output
architecture.validation: JSON structure → command field exists → command registry lookup
architecture.routing: Command name string → handler function mapping
architecture.error_handling: JsonError with code, message, fix_hint, fix_command

missing_pieces: No correlation ID tracking (but JsonResponse structure supports it)

gleam_stdlib_for_stdin.note: Gleam stdlib doesn't have readline, need Erlang FFI or file:read_line
